newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - First Data target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - First Data target raised.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said Wednesday it raised its price target on First Data Corp but trimmed its 1998 earnings estimate.
-- Raised target to $50-52 per share range.

-- Projects revenue growth of more than 20 percent in three core businesses -- domestic card issuer services, merchant processing and payment instruments -- and 12 percent revenue growth in international card services.
-- Cut 1998 estimate to $1.90 per share from $1.92 to reflect revenue loss from the company's sale of First Health businesses.
